$comment: Single source of truth for the Code Block API. Every framework package is tested against this file.
name: code-block
title: Code Block
description: Code with a file name, a copy button and optional line numbers and highlighted lines.
thumb:
app.js
const a = 1;let b = "hi";

code.description: The code, as plain text. It is escaped for you.

html.description: Code that is already highlighted (by Shiki, Prism or the token classes below). Used instead of code; trust only HTML you made. With lineNumbers or highlight, keep every token on one line.
html.html: your highlighted HTML inside the code element

filename.description: Shown in the header, with the copy button.

language.description: A short label in the header, such as "tsx" or "bash".

lineNumbers.description: Number the lines. The numbers are drawn by CSS, so they are never copied or read out.

highlight.description: Line numbers to highlight, starting at 1.

token classes.description: Optional colours for hand-written highlighting, drawn from the theme: keyword, string, number, comment.

examples.title: Basic
examples.description: A file name, the language and a copy button. In HTML, add data-vin-copy to the button and include vinui.js.

examples.title: Line numbers and highlights
examples.description: Numbered lines, two highlighted lines and pre-highlighted tokens. Long lines scroll sideways instead of wrapping.

examples.title: Without a header
examples.description: A one-line command. The copy button sits in the corner.

a11y: The copy button has a name ("Copy code") and a polite live region (role="status") says "Copied" when it works.
Line numbers are CSS counters with empty alternative text, so they are not copied with the code and screen readers skip them.
The code can be scrolled sideways with the keyboard: the pre has tabindex="0" and a focus ring.
Highlighted lines are a visual aid only; say in the text around the block why they matter.
Token colours come from the theme and meet 4.5:1 contrast in every style, light and dark.
